authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No generic Grixis Thoracle/Breach turbo conversion (decisions L24).
Keep creatures that can enter and connect the same turn.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Flying blockers, fogs or wipes stop fresh creatures connecting.
New Dragons lack haste in later combats without Samut/Tempest or another activation.

value.interaction: Counters and cheap removal (Mana Drain, Counterspell, Swan Song, Terminate, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge).
value.mana: Three-mana commander; Sol Ring, Ancient Tomb, Talismans, Treasure from combat.
value.protection: Lightning Greaves, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Goro-Goro is the Dragon factory and the haste source the whole combat plan runs through.
accepted_role.honest_note: The trigger needs creatures that entered this turn to connect, so blockers and fogs hurt; his own haste only covers creatures already in play when it resolves (M1 goro-02). Breath of Fury goes infinite with four other cards without him.
